jsmath.note: inputs from mulberry32(seed) by the formulas in gen-golden.js, then every special (unary) or every special pair (binary); hash is FNV-1a over the outputs' f64 bits, little endian

guard.note: square: L = 0.3 + (fract(t * hz) < 0.5 ? amp : 0); chirp: L = 0.5 + 0.4 * sin(TAU * t * (1 + 2 * t)); random: L = mulberry32(seed)(); t = i / fps, or with fps 0 the jitter schedule. limited lists [i, Lo] where Lo != L; hash is FNV-1a over every Lo; meters are createFlashMeter() rates: the maximum on the raw L, and every rate times 2 on the guarded Lo.
